description: Paper-convention runs with J = h = 1, T in {1, 2}, r in {1, 2, 3, 7}, and cubic noise scaling.
sign_convention: Paper convention: rx = -h and rzz = -J, so rxT = -h*T and rzzT = -J*T.
notes: This directory stores the cubic-noise tensor-network runs.
Noise values use the r = [1, 2, 3, 7] cubic scale plus zero; the joint path should use the reversed nonzero sequence [343, 27, 8, 1].
The batch config maps rxT/rzzT into h/J at runtime using h = -rxT/T and J = -rzzT/T.
